profile.headline: Support Engineer | Software Development & Customer Advocacy
profile.summary:
I spent three years as a Support Engineer (L3) and Software Engineer intern, where I built a strong foundation in software development, Video/Data Support, and demonstrated expertise in debugging, product development, customer relationship management, and creating dashboards/database tools. I'm currently comparing code and software responses to train AI models, focused on continuous model improvement.

During three years in biotech research, I developed a foundation in data analytics, Python scripting, and bioinformatics. I'm passionate about innovation and open to roles in both startups and established organizations.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Comparing code and software responses to train AI models, focused on continuous model improvement
- Python, JavaScript, and associated libraries

positions.title: Support Engineer (L3)
positions.description:
Customer Support & Technical Enablement:
- Resolved complex technical issues for developer customers (100% CSAT score).
- Led product support during Mux Player release
- Trained hires, refined support team processes
- Analyzed customer dashboard data errors and logs

Software Development & Technical Content:
- Developed React.js frontend pages from Figma designs
- Enhanced Mux Docs: Embedded Mux video script, fixed 150+ broken links
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Support · Software Development · Product · Figma

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Developed a full-stack tool for system administrators to update metadata for 50 user accounts, handling 5 error types and building a responsive UI.
- Resolved 20+ backend/frontend bugs, including DynamoDB edits, Tornado handler logic, Python coroutines, React/Angular fixes, and dashboard UI/CSS improvements.
- Conducted code reviews, UX testing, and managed issue tracking.

positions.title: Software Engineer + Project Manager Intern
positions.description:
- Developed Vue.js components for an ML/AI SaaS dashboard, including validated forms and two-factor login.
- Redesigned the dashboard with scalable SVGs and improved UI/UX.
- Implemented secure user data storage with GCP Firestore/Firebase.
- Optimized non-relational database for scalability.
- Integrated the backend ML/AI model with Node.js.

Buzz Solutions Inc. (http://buzzsolutions.co/) is a StartX Accelerator startup. Images collected by drones are passed through the proprietary AI platform, which uses computer vision and deep learning technologies to detect faults and provide insights on power lines. This allows safer inspections for workers, prevents power cuts, and deters other unwanted ecological impacts such as fires.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
- Researching on the Strain Analytics team, ran real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) on high-throughput 384-well plates and scaled laboratory processes 
- Generated and analyzed ~7kb of gene-expression data and devised test-driven improvements on core protocols
- Presented statistical findings in a 60-minute tech talk/Q&A with chief scientists and executives

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
- Cloned a library of CRISPR/Cas9 plasmid products, high-throughput sequencing and BLAST analysis of products
- Assisted with antibody purification and other routine laboratory tasks

positions.title: Research Assistant, Endocrinology and Medicine
positions.description:
- Assisted with research on beta cells in pancreatic islets
- Performed procedures including PCR, slide preparation, immunohistochemistry, fluorescent imaging and quantification (OpenLab)

positions.title: Accounting Intern
positions.description:
-Reorganized fixed assets and depreciation using FAS (software) for a medium-sized packaging production company
-Assisted CFO with managerial/accounting tasks
